calibration_limits: THIS FILE IS ONLY TRUE WITH --camera-rectify. focal_px 545.9 describes the SYNTHETIC equidistant projection that lite3_front_camera_rectify_20260901.json produces, not the raw lens. Passed as --calibration without that flag it is wrong at every bearing.

The raw lens is nearly rectilinear (fx 508.7, fy 494.9, HFOV 103 deg). The shared FisheyeCamera model is equidistant and cannot express it; on raw frames it reports 48.1 deg for a true 40 deg. That cost the 2026-08-31 live run a 281% range swing on a stationary box across 63 deg of yaw.
pitch_rad and height_m are the physical mounting and are unchanged by rectification; they carry over from the two-station elevation fit (residual -0.57 deg).
SUPERSEDES focal_px 469.63 (shipped), 888.85 (spin), 660 and 392.4 (both fitted by hand on 2026-08-31). All four were attempts to repair a wrong equation with a scalar.

validation.REQUIRES: --camera-rectify lite3_front_camera_rectify_20260901.json. Without it this file is wrong at every bearing, because it describes a projection the raw camera does not produce.
validation.what_is_NOT_asserted: Absolute scale beyond a few percent. The rectification converts the measured pinhole model faithfully and cannot beat it; that fit carries RMS 2.94 px, fx/fy 1.028 and no coverage of the frame's top third. Stability across bearing is fixed; absolute range is not independently verified against a tape at more than one distance.
validation.what_is_asserted: That focal_px 545.9 correctly describes the SYNTHETIC equidistant projection produced by lite3_front_camera_rectify_20260901.json, measured 2026-09-01 from 26 ArUco grid-board views by cv2.calibrateCamera (pinhole RMS 2.94 px) and validated end to end against an accurate pinhole pose over bearings -51..+28 deg: range error mean +0.0% / sd 0.2% / worst 0.9%, bearing error mean +0.01 deg / worst 0.18 deg.
